fields.statement: At 9ce21088, verifier ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/machine/... -v: TestMachineNeverWritesFiles, TestMachineExportsOnlyReaders and TestNothingElseTouchesMachineFile (go/parser over non-test source; os/ioutil writers incl.
